look_here_first: Expect an intermediate ironweed. Plants occur where western ironweed and woolly ironweed meet, with foliage, hairiness, leaf width, and head characters falling between the parents.

key_traits.label: Family pattern
key_traits.text: Asteraceae head made entirely of purple disc florets; no ray florets.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: intermediate between V. baldwinii and V. lindheimeri

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: often found where parent habitats meet

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: mature flowering material and nearby parents are important for confident ID

lookalikes.differences: Do not force intermediate ironweeds into one parent. V. lindheimeri has narrow strongly revolute leaves with dense white hairs beneath; V. baldwinii has broader less-woolly foliage. The hybrid spans the middle.
